safety_first.description: C2 and safety protection dominate throughput and overhead.

balanced.description: C2 safety, RID compliance, throughput, overhead, and mismatch are comparable.

throughput_preserving.description: Payload/video throughput is important; fallback and unnecessary shaping are penalized.

notes: Each JSONL mission record is the gold cost profile for that natural-language intent.
The fields gold_cost_profile, guards, family_mix, and cost_weights are treated as manually checked labels for the LLM compiler evaluation.
These gold profiles are not physical constants; they are reviewer-facing operational preferences used to audit whether mission intent is compiled into a safe structured decision context.
